title: Ganzoni Formula — Total Iron Deficit (IV iron)
subtitle: adults >35 kg with iron-deficiency anaemia · ward / antenatal

sources.title: STG & EML Hospital Level Adults, 6th ed. 2024 (updated Mar 2026)
National Integrated Maternal & Perinatal Care Guidelines for SA, 5th ed. 2024
Ganzoni AM. Schweiz Med Wochenschr 1970;100:301-3; SAHPRA PI Monofer (2023)

items.name: Total iron deficit (mg)
items.expr: weight (kg) × (target Hb − actual Hb) (g/dL) × 2.4 + iron stores (mg)
items.notes: target Hb 15 g/dL (lower in pregnancy); stores 500 mg if >35 kg

items.name: Weight
items.expr: ideal body weight if obese; pre-pregnancy weight in pregnancy

items.t: Iron sucrose 200 mg in 200 mL NaCl 0.9% over 30 min, up to 3 × weekly until total calculated dose
An initial total of 600 mg is usually adequate
Low-molecular-weight iron dextran 100–200 mg 2–3 × weekly, or total-dose infusion up to 20 mg/kg over 4–6 h
Pregnancy: iron sucrose on alternate days to 600 mg, in specialist consultation
Max single dose depends on product — check the package insert (iron sucrose 200 mg/dose)
Observe 30 min after each infusion for hypersensitivity; resuscitation available
<35 kg or children: check the product PI (not verified here)
Recheck Hb and ferritin after ≥4 weeks
